title: Pointwise overlap equality for twist representatives
statement: Under the hypotheses and local evaluation data of lem-sc-proj-twist-local-overlap-compatibility, for any fixed chart indices i,j the two canonical representatives have equal value at every homogeneous prime of the basic open.

source.place: local fraction comparison on the overlap

proof.text: Use IsLocalizedModule.surj to choose x,y in A_f and denominators d in powers(g_i), e in powers(g_j) with d*t_i=x/1 and e*t_j=y/1. At any homogeneous prime where g_i*g_j is invertible, both factors are invertible. Apply the two additive evaluations to these equations; scalar compatibility and their common section value give F(e*x-d*y)=0.

Prove the private helper principal_localization_zero: for z in A_f whose evaluation vanishes wherever a degree-zero fraction g is invertible, write z=a/d with d a power of f. Every prime of D_+(f*g.num) avoids f and g.num, and g.den is a power of f; hence g is invertible there and a evaluates to zero. Apply basicOpen_localization_detection to a/1 in A_(f*g.num), whose homogeneous denominator has positive degree b+g.deg. Localization equality supplies N with (f*g.num)^N*a=0. Map to A_f and cancel powers of f, d, and g.den to get g^N*z=0, proving z/1=0 in the module localization at g. This also treats g=0, nilpotent f, and zero rings without a nonemptiness assumption.

Apply the helper to g_i*g_j and the cross numerator e*x-d*y. The universal lift formula IsLocalizedModule.lift_apply and linearity identify its localized equality with d*e times equality of the two lifted representatives. localizationAway_map_units_of_dvd makes d and e unit endomorphisms on the product localization. Use Module.End.isUnit_iff to cancel them.

proof_origin.place: Basic-overlap fraction comparison, made explicit by J3 using cross numerators, homogeneous numerator detection and cancellation of localization denominators.

theorem twist_localOverlap_pointwise
    {A σ : Type v} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (k : ℤ) (f : A) (b : ℕ)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 b)
    (s : (twist 𝒜 k).val.obj (op (basicOpen 𝒜 f)))
    (n : ℕ) (g : Fin n → HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f)
    (t : ∀ i : Fin n, LocalizedModule.Away (g i)
      (LocalizedModule.Away f A))
    (hlocal : ∀ (i : Fin n) (p : basicOpen 𝒜 f),
      let F := IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers f)
        (T := p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl)
        (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) (RingHom.id A)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr p.2)
      IsUnit (F (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f)
        (LocalizedModule.Away f A) (g i))) →
      ∃ e : LocalizedModule.Away (g i) (LocalizedModule.Away f A) →+
          Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal,
        (∀ z : LocalizedModule.Away f A,
          e (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (g i))
            (LocalizedModule.Away f A) z) = F z) ∧
        (∀ (a : HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f)
          (x : LocalizedModule.Away (g i) (LocalizedModule.Away f A)),
          e (a • x) = F (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f)
            (LocalizedModule.Away f A) a) * e x) ∧
        e (t i) = (s.1 p).1)
    (i j : Fin n) :
      let ρ := fun (a h : HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f) (ha : a ∣ h) ↦
        IsLocalizedModule.lift (Submonoid.powers a)
          (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers a)
            (LocalizedModule.Away f A))
          (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers h)
            (LocalizedModule.Away f A))
          (RingTheory.localizationAway_map_units_of_dvd
            (M := LocalizedModule.Away f A) a h ha)
      ρ (g i) (g i * g j) (dvd_mul_right (g i) (g j)) (t i) =
        ρ (g j) (g i * g j) (dvd_mul_left (g j) (g i)) (t j)
